description:
Dexcom Clarity for Government online software is an important part of the Dexcom Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) system. It provides a holistic and retrospective view of CGM User diabetes management by highlighting glucose patterns, trends, and statistics to help providers make diabetes management decisions.
CGM Users can connect their Dexcom Clarity data to the clinic account using a secure code. During visits, providers can upload CGM User receiver data to the clinic account directly. 
Dexcom has deployed a separate Google Cloud organization for the federal system in Google Cloud Central US region with multiple zones for redundancy.
Dexcom Clarity for Government includes a subset of the services and features available in the commercial system and leverages cloud-native and cloud-managed services wherever possible.
Dexcom Clarity for Government includes Dexcom Clarity for Government, applications and their associated services and utilities and uses private Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) clusters with the Autopilot feature for their compute.

description: GetWell Anywhere Federal (GWA-F) is a comprehensive digital patient engagement platform designed to guide, educate, entertain, navigate, and survey patients throughout their entire care journey. From pre-procedure preparation to the ED waiting room, inpatient settings, and post-discharge recovery, GWA-F ensures continuous support. Integrated with EMR systems, it provides automated, personalized, and proactive guidance for each patient, achieving scalable, individualized care through web and mobile applications. Additionally, GWA-F automates repetitive tasks for clinicians—such as patient education, EMR documentation, and non-clinical requests—allowing them to focus on providing top-of-license care.

description: The GTS-VP offers Customer Agencies a powerful, flexible and convenient solution to provide Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), Real Time Telehealth visits, and Store and Forward Technology (labs, images, and clinical data) services. The GTS-VP connects healthcare providers, patients, and patient families to communicate healthcare information from remote patient monitoring tools and through video-teleconferencing. The GTS-VP integrates with RPM medical devices from most any manufacturer and can be readily configured to work across multiple disease types and chronic conditions. The GTS-VP is also designed to make use of existing agency workflows and business processes with the ability to expand to address conditions and incorporate devices and capabilities that have yet to be developed.

description: RevCycle Health Services Platform (RHSP) is a platform which hosts and supports the operations of key Solventum software systems.
